rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone is unwilling to do or accept something.

example.english: I am averse to eating such spicy food.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 jyun6 ji3 sik6 gam3 laat6 ge3 je5

rows.note: Choose this when the aversion is mainly a feeling of dislike or repugnance toward something.

example.english: I am averse to the smell of cigarette smoke.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 jin1 mei6 hou3 faan2 gam2

rows.note: Choose this when someone actively resists or opposes something rather than merely disliking it.

example.english: They are averse to the company suddenly changing their work hours.
example.traditional: 佢哋好抗拒公司突然改工時。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hou2 kong3 keoi5 gung1 si1 dat6 jin4 goi2 gung1 si4
